description: This bike is for racers obsessed with achieving the perfect balance of aerodynamics, weight and rigidity. RCR stands for "racer", because that's who it's for.

components.description: SRAM Force disc brakes with 160 mm discs at the front and 140 mm at the rear.; The SRAM Force brakes are hydraulic. This gives you progressive, more powerful braking than with cable-actuated hydraulic brakes.; You will need to bed these brakes in. Simply brake gradually 20 times at a low speed (20 km/h), then repeat at 30 km/h. Make sure to bed in both brakes.
Bedding in creates more friction between the disc and brake pad.
SRAM Force chain; The SRAM elements are easy to replace, with the Force and Rival ranges being compatible.
FORCE D2 DUB PM 48/35T; Crank length by size; XS: 165; S: 170 mm; M: 172.5 mm; L/XL: 175 mm
The RCR's fork weighs 380 g (painted) in size M

We've integrated the parts of the headset so that the RCR steers smoothly while remaining easy to maintain.; DEDA SUPERZERO RS handlebar (carbon); Deda measurements are taken from the ends (ex: a 400 mm handlebar measured between axles = a 420 mm handlebar from Deda); Width between axles:; XS/S: 400 mm; M/L: 420 mm; XL: 440 mm; Pressure between 3 and 5 bar (max).; Weight per pair: 1470g; 700x28: pressure between 3 and 5 bar; 240 g

There may be slight variations in weight depending on the colour (+/- 50 g).; It's light and reliable thanks to the Michelin Aramid Shield technology and the 3 x 120 TPI carcass. The Michelin GUM-X compound grips the road well and keeps you stable on both dry and wet ground.
The RCR bike is equipped with the SRAM Force eTap AXS complete groupset and Quarq power meter. A power meter is a must for cyclists who want to plan their training to help them improve.

FIZIK ARGO VENTO R5 saddle or FIZIK ANTARES R5 saddle, depending on version.; These racing saddles developed in partnership with professional racers have a short nose to promote stability and relieve pressure on the soft tissue area.; Weight: 225 g (140 mm)
DEDA x VAN RYSEL Superbox EVO: the stem is lightweight yet sufficiently rigid; XS: 80 mm; S: 90 mm; M: 100 mm; L: 110 mm; XL: 120 mm

Internal width of 23mm to handle 28mm cross-section tyres.; Boost your confidence with the Michelin Power Cup road tyre for competitions and training. This tyre is used by the Cofidis team for competitions. It has been directly inspired by MotoGP technology, bringing you speed and performance.

Total drive train weight: 2920 g with power meter; The electronic groupset has two separate batteries (one for each derailleur). You can use the SRAM app to set up your bike and view data from your rides.

The 404 wheel from ZIPP has been honed for increased performance. 100% carbon tubeless ready hookless wheel.; It has a depth of 58 mm, just like the previous version, but also benefits from the new ZR1 hub, which is smoother and creates less friction when freewheeling.
